sub_limits_waiting_notes: IRDAI Arogya Sanjeevani standard product. Listed specific diseases (cataract, hernia, joint replacement etc.) have 24-month waiting; PED 36 months.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Room rent up to 2% of SI subject to max Rs.5,000/day. ICU up to 5% of SI subject to max Rs.10,000/day. Proportionate deductions on other expenses if higher room category chosen.
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Includes nursing, surgeon, anaesthetist, consultants, OT, drugs, implants, diagnostics.

ayush_coverage.notes: Inpatient AYUSH treatment in recognised AYUSH hospital up to SI.

room_rent_capping: Up to 2% of SI per day, capped at Rs.5,000 per day.
icu_capping: Up to 5% of SI per day, capped at Rs.10,000 per day.
copayment_trigger_notes: 5% co-payment applies on every admissible claim (IRDAI standard Arogya Sanjeevani feature).

disease_wise_sub_limits.cataract: Up to 25% of SI or Rs.40,000 (lower) per eye per policy year
disease_wise_sub_limits.advanced_procedures_listed: Modern treatments (Robotic surgery, Stem-cell therapy, Oral chemo, etc.) up to 50% of SI

notable_exclusions_summary: IRDAI standard Arogya Sanjeevani exclusions apply: cosmetic, obesity (without criteria), substance abuse, breach of law, infertility, unproven treatments, overseas care.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via network hospital with TPA pre-authorisation or reimbursement with original bills, discharge summary and KYC. Go Digit operates 24x7 toll-free helpline.
